start.title: Riser Hit sfx 031.wav
start.author: AudioPapkin
start.about: Page: riser into a hit, "perfect for cinematic uses, video games"; field-recorded (Zoom H6). Tags: build, cinematic, hit, impact, implosion, intro.

start.title: One hit (sonar inspired)
start.author: xkeril
start.about: Page: bright cinematic impact/stab with reverb from a processed metal jar, "sounding like a sonar or a radar". Audible ~2.2 s.

start.title: Transition (hit and whoosh)
start.author: xkeril
start.about: Page: modern transition, two impacts and a whoosh (processed metal jar), tuned to C at 90 bpm. Audible ~2.6 s.

won.title: Stage Clear
won.author: Qvantor
won.about: ROUND WON (pair A). Page: wide supersaw chord gated in four quick pulses, then held as the filter opens; "electronic wins".

won.title: Congrats! 2
won.author: nomiqbomi
won.about: ROUND WON (pair B). Page: "A short, happy orchestral stinger."

won.title: Level Up / Mission Complete
won.author: Beetlemuse
won.about: ROUND WON (extra). Page: level-up sound / "a nice Fanfare for winning a battle".

won.title: Success
won.author: Sjonas88
won.about: ROUND WON (extra). Page: simple "success" C-major synth chord (Arturia MicroFreak). Short hit, then a quiet tail.

lost.title: Dramatic Piano Sting
lost.author: Qvantor
lost.about: ROUND LOST (pair A). Page: low piano octaves with a sub, in a hall - "for drama, bad news, tension". Audible ~4.5 s.

lost.title: Dissonant Piano Sting 8
lost.author: nomiqbomi
lost.about: ROUND LOST (pair B). Page: soft dissonant piano sting (Logic Pro X); tags dark, eerie, dramatic. Quiet (peak -12.9 dB) - needs gain.

victory.title: Victory (short sting)
victory.author: xkeril
victory.about: VICTORY (pair with the next). Page: bright major-key bumper, bells + piano-type sound + home-made sfx. Audible ~3.8 s.

victory.title: Epic Sting
victory.author: iwanPlays
victory.about: VICTORY. Page: short electronic/synth sting made with VSTs for announcing a key word; tags epic, fanfare, success. Loud (mean -12.6 dB).

victory.title: Finish Line Stinger
victory.author: SterlingRay
victory.about: VICTORY. Page only says it was made with Soundtrap sfx, keyboards and loops (title suggests a race-finish win). ~7.7 s audible.

defeat.title: You've been trapped (short sting)
defeat.author: xkeril
defeat.about: DEFEAT (pair with the previous). Page: descending minor-key bumper, "a bad thing happening", same bells/piano palette. Audible ~4 s.

defeat.title: Game Over Dark (gameoverdark)
defeat.author: Robin Lamb
defeat.about: DEFEAT. Page: game-over clip "with a darker sound". Quiet (peak -10.9 dB), 10 s.

defeat.title: Lose Game Short Music Clip
defeat.author: Robin Lamb
defeat.about: DEFEAT. Page: short clip for when a game is lost, made from the public-domain VSCO 2 CE / VCSL sample libraries. ~5.7 s audible.
